claims.name: Swf.AppChallenge.found_only_on_target
claims.statement:
∀ (task task' : Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeTask) (id : String) (time : Nat) (r : Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeRecord),
  Swf.AppChallenge.challengeStep task (Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeEvent.selected id time) =
      Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeAnswer.next task' (some r) →
    ∃ run,
      task.run = some run ∧
        id = run.target ∧
          run.startedAt ≤ time ∧
            r = { target := run.target, method := run.method, ms := time - run.startedAt, actions := run.actions } ∧
              task' = { run := none, records := task.records.push r }

claims.name: Swf.AppChallenge.names_one_when_any
claims.statement:
∀ (candidates : Array Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeCandidate) (selected : Option String) (draw : Nat)
  (c : Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeCandidate),
  c ∈ candidates → some c.id ≠ selected → (Swf.AppChallenge.challengeTarget candidates selected draw).isSome = true

claims.name: Swf.AppChallenge.other_selection_changes_nothing
claims.statement:
∀ (task : Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeTask) (id : String) (time : Nat),
  (∀ (r : Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeRun), task.run = some r → id ≠ r.target) →
    Swf.AppChallenge.challengeStep task (Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeEvent.selected id time) =
      Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeAnswer.next task none

claims.name: Swf.AppChallenge.prefers_behind
claims.statement:
∀ (candidates : Array Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeCandidate) (selected : Option String) (draw : Nat)
  (b : Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeCandidate),
  b ∈ candidates →
    b.behind = true →
      some b.id ≠ selected →
        ∃ c, c ∈ candidates ∧ Swf.AppChallenge.challengeTarget candidates selected draw = some c.id ∧ c.behind = true

claims.name: Swf.AppChallenge.records_only_grow
claims.statement:
∀ (task task' : Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeTask) (e : Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeEvent)
  (found : Option Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeRecord),
  e ≠ Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeEvent.clear →
    ∀ (h : Swf.AppChallenge.challengeStep task e = Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeAnswer.next task' found),
      task'.records =
        match found, h with
        | none, h => task.records
        | some r, h => task.records.push r

claims.name: Swf.AppChallenge.target_is_an_unselected_candidate
claims.statement:
∀ (candidates : Array Swf.AppChallenge.ChallengeCandidate) (selected : Option String) (draw : Nat) (id : String),
  Swf.AppChallenge.challengeTarget candidates selected draw = some id →
    ∃ c, c ∈ candidates ∧ c.id = id ∧ some id ≠ selected

claims.name: Swf.AppComposition.detach_needs_two_surfaces
claims.statement:
∀ (s : Swf.AppComposition.CompScene) (r : Swf.AppComposition.CompRef) (sf w created label : String)
  (parentId : Option String) (kept : Array String),
  Swf.AppComposition.compositionPlan s (Swf.AppComposition.CompStep.detach r) =
      Swf.AppComposition.CompPlan.detach sf w created label parentId kept →
    ∃ n,
      s.window? (some w) = some n ∧
        2 ≤ n.surfaceIds.size ∧
          kept = Array.filter (fun x => x != sf) n.surfaceIds ∧ parentId = n.parentId ∧ ¬created ∈ s.ids

claims.name: Swf.AppComposition.emptied_group_removed_only
claims.statement:
∀ (s : Swf.AppComposition.CompScene) (r : Swf.AppComposition.CompRef) (t : Swf.AppComposition.CompTarget) (w : String)
  (into : Swf.AppComposition.CompInto) (g : String),
  Swf.AppComposition.compositionPlan s (Swf.AppComposition.CompStep.regroup r t) =
      Swf.AppComposition.CompPlan.regroup w into (some g) →
    ∃ n left,
      s.window? r.id = some n ∧
        n.parentId.bind s.node? = some left ∧
          left.id = g ∧
            left.kind = "group" ∧
              s.orbitRootId ≠ some g ∧
                left.childIds.size = 1 ∧ left.surfaceIds.size = 0 ∧ ∃ id, t = Swf.AppComposition.CompTarget.group id

claims.name: Swf.AppComposition.emptying_refused_alike
claims.statement:
∀ (s : Swf.AppComposition.CompScene) (r t : Swf.AppComposition.CompRef) (sf : Swf.AppComposition.CompSurface)
  (source : Swf.AppComposition.CompNode),
  r.id.bind s.surface? = some sf →
    s.window? (some sf.owner) = some source →
      (∃ target, s.window? t.id = some target ∧ target.id ≠ sf.owner) →
        (Array.filter (fun x => x != sf.id) source.surfaceIds).size = 0 →
          source.childIds.size > 0 →
            Swf.AppComposition.compositionPlan s (Swf.AppComposition.CompStep.move r t) =
                Swf.AppComposition.CompPlan.refused "surfaceId" (Swf.AppComposition.holdsNodes source) ∧
              ∀ (t' : Swf.AppComposition.CompRef) (target' : Swf.AppComposition.CompNode),
                s.window? t'.id = some target' →
                  target'.id ≠ source.id →
                    Swf.AppComposition.compositionPlan s
                        (Swf.AppComposition.CompStep.merge { id := some source.id, shown := source.id } t') =
                      Swf.AppComposition.CompPlan.refused "windowId" (Swf.AppComposition.holdsNodes source)

claims.name: Swf.AppComposition.free_id_prefers_stem
claims.statement: ∀ (taken : Array String) (stem : String), ¬stem ∈ taken → Swf.AppComposition.compositionFreeId taken stem = stem

claims.name: Swf.AppComposition.free_id_unused
claims.statement: ∀ (taken : Array String) (stem : String), ¬Swf.AppComposition.compositionFreeId taken stem ∈ taken

claims.name: Swf.AppComposition.group_gathers_named_windows
claims.statement:
∀ (s : Swf.AppComposition.CompScene) (rs : Array Swf.AppComposition.CompRef) (id label gid glabel : String)
  (ws : Array String) (parentId : Option String) (removed : Array String),
  Swf.AppComposition.compositionPlan s (Swf.AppComposition.CompStep.group rs id label) =
      Swf.AppComposition.CompPlan.group ws gid glabel parentId removed →
    2 ≤ ws.size ∧
      ws.toList.Nodup ∧
        (∀ (w : String), w ∈ ws → ∃ n, s.window? (some w) = some n) ∧ gid = id ∧ glabel = label ∧ ¬gid ∈ s.ids

claims.name: Swf.AppComposition.group_removes_only_emptied
claims.statement:
∀ (s : Swf.AppComposition.CompScene) (rs : Array Swf.AppComposition.CompRef) (id label gid glabel : String)
  (ws : Array String) (parentId : Option String) (removed : Array String),
  Swf.AppComposition.compositionPlan s (Swf.AppComposition.CompStep.group rs id label) =
      Swf.AppComposition.CompPlan.group ws gid glabel parentId removed →
    ∀ (g : String),
      g ∈ removed →
        ∃ left,
          s.node? g = some left ∧
            left.kind = "group" ∧
              s.orbitRootId ≠ some g ∧
                left.surfaceIds.size = 0 ∧ (∀ (c : String), c ∈ left.childIds → c ∈ ws) ∧ parentId ≠ some g

claims.name: Swf.AppComposition.merge_keeps_every_surface
claims.statement:
∀ (s : Swf.AppComposition.CompScene) (r t : Swf.AppComposition.CompRef) (source target : String)
  (moved laidOut : Array String),
  Swf.AppComposition.compositionPlan s (Swf.AppComposition.CompStep.merge r t) =
      Swf.AppComposition.CompPlan.merge source target moved laidOut →
    ∃ ns nt,
      s.window? r.id = some ns ∧
        s.window? t.id = some nt ∧
          ns.id = source ∧
            nt.id = target ∧
              source ≠ target ∧ ns.childIds.size = 0 ∧ moved = ns.surfaceIds ∧ laidOut = nt.surfaceIds ++ ns.surfaceIds

claims.name: Swf.AppComposition.move_keeps_every_surface
claims.statement:
∀ (s : Swf.AppComposition.CompScene) (r t : Swf.AppComposition.CompRef) (sf target source : String)
  (laidOut left : Array String),
  Swf.AppComposition.compositionPlan s (Swf.AppComposition.CompStep.move r t) =
      Swf.AppComposition.CompPlan.move sf target laidOut source left →
    ∃ nt ns,
      s.window? t.id = some nt ∧
        s.window? (some source) = some ns ∧
          nt.id = target ∧
            ns.id = source ∧
              target ≠ source ∧
                laidOut = nt.surfaceIds.push sf ∧
                  left = Array.filter (fun x => x != sf) ns.surfaceIds ∧ (left.size = 0 → ns.childIds.size = 0)

claims.name: Swf.AppComposition.recombine_keeps_every_surface
claims.statement:
∀ (s : Swf.AppComposition.CompScene) (r : Swf.AppComposition.CompRef) (rs : Array Swf.AppComposition.CompRef)
  (w : String) (moved laidOut removed : Array String),
  Swf.AppComposition.compositionPlan s (Swf.AppComposition.CompStep.recombine r rs) =
      Swf.AppComposition.CompPlan.recombine w moved laidOut removed →
    ∃ origin,
      s.window? r.id = some origin ∧
        origin.id = w ∧
          0 < removed.size ∧
            removed.toList.Nodup ∧
              ¬w ∈ removed ∧
                laidOut = origin.surfaceIds ++ moved ∧
                  ∀ (p : String), p ∈ removed → ∃ n, s.window? (some p) = some n ∧ n.childIds.size = 0

claims.name: Swf.AppComposition.regroup_into_other_group
claims.statement:
∀ (s : Swf.AppComposition.CompScene) (r : Swf.AppComposition.CompRef) (t : Swf.AppComposition.CompTarget) (w : String)
  (into : Swf.AppComposition.CompInto) (removed : Option String),
  Swf.AppComposition.compositionPlan s (Swf.AppComposition.CompStep.regroup r t) =
      Swf.AppComposition.CompPlan.regroup w into removed →
    ∃ n,
      s.window? r.id = some n ∧
        n.id = w ∧
          ((∃ g,
              into = Swf.AppComposition.CompInto.group g.id ∧
                s.node? g.id = some g ∧ g.kind = "group" ∧ g.active = true ∧ n.parentId ≠ some g.id) ∨
            ∃ id label, into = Swf.AppComposition.CompInto.fresh id label n.parentId ∧ ¬id ∈ s.ids)

claims.name: Swf.AppComposition.split_keeps_every_surface
claims.statement:
∀ (s : Swf.AppComposition.CompScene) (r : Swf.AppComposition.CompRef) (w kept : String) (parentId : Option String)
  (parts : Array (String × String × String)),
  Swf.AppComposition.compositionPlan s (Swf.AppComposition.CompStep.split r) =
      Swf.AppComposition.CompPlan.split w kept parentId parts →
    ∃ n,
      s.window? r.id = some n ∧
        n.id = w ∧
          2 ≤ n.surfaceIds.size ∧
            n.surfaceIds.toList = kept :: List.map (fun x => x.fst) parts.toList ∧
              (∀ (x : String × String × String), x ∈ parts → ¬x.snd.fst ∈ s.ids) ∧
                (List.map (fun x => x.snd.fst) parts.toList).Nodup

claims.name: Swf.AppComposition.window_with_nodes_never_emptied
claims.statement:
∀ (s : Swf.AppComposition.CompScene) (w : Swf.AppComposition.CompNode),
  s.window? (some w.id) = some w →
    w.childIds.size > 0 →
      (∀ (r t : Swf.AppComposition.CompRef) (sf target : String) (laidOut left : Array String),
          Swf.AppComposition.compositionPlan s (Swf.AppComposition.CompStep.move r t) =
              Swf.AppComposition.CompPlan.move sf target laidOut w.id left →
            left.size ≠ 0) ∧
        ∀ (r t : Swf.AppComposition.CompRef) (target : String) (moved laidOut : Array String),
          Swf.AppComposition.compositionPlan s (Swf.AppComposition.CompStep.merge r t) ≠
            Swf.AppComposition.CompPlan.merge w.id target moved laidOut

claims.name: Swf.AppCursor.asks_only_at_the_edge_of_a_held_drag
claims.statement:
∀ (st st' : Swf.AppCursor.CursorState) (s : Swf.AppCursor.WrapSample) (f : Swf.AppCursor.WrapFrame) (x y : Float)
  (as : List Swf.AppCursor.CursorAction),
  Swf.AppCursor.sampleStep st s f = Swf.AppCursor.SampleStep.next st' x y as →
    Swf.AppCursor.CursorAction.request ∈ as →
      st.lock = Swf.AppCursor.PointerLock.free ∧
        s.key ∈ st.taken ∧
          f.wraps = true ∧
            f.lockable = true ∧
              s.mouse = true ∧ s.phase = Swf.AppCursor.WrapPhase.move ∧ Swf.AppCursor.nearEdge s.x f.width = true

claims.name: Swf.AppCursor.closing_leaves_nothing
claims.statement:
∀ (st : Swf.AppCursor.CursorState),
  (Swf.AppCursor.cursorEvent st Swf.AppCursor.CursorEvent.closed).state = Swf.AppCursor.cursorInitial ∧
    (st.lock ≠ Swf.AppCursor.PointerLock.free →
        (∀ (k : String), st.lock ≠ Swf.AppCursor.PointerLock.refused k) →
          Swf.AppCursor.CursorAction.exit ∈ (Swf.AppCursor.cursorEvent st Swf.AppCursor.CursorEvent.closed).actions) ∧
      (st.drawn = true →
        Swf.AppCursor.CursorAction.hide ∈ (Swf.AppCursor.cursorEvent st Swf.AppCursor.CursorEvent.closed).actions)

claims.name: Swf.AppCursor.escape_ends_the_locked_drag
claims.statement:
∀ (st : Swf.AppCursor.CursorState) (key : String) (x y : Float),
  st.lock = Swf.AppCursor.PointerLock.held key x y ∨ st.lock = Swf.AppCursor.PointerLock.asked key x y →
    (Swf.AppCursor.cursorEvent st Swf.AppCursor.CursorEvent.escape).state.lock = Swf.AppCursor.PointerLock.letting ∧
      List.take 2 (Swf.AppCursor.cursorEvent st Swf.AppCursor.CursorEvent.escape).actions =
        [Swf.AppCursor.CursorAction.exit, Swf.AppCursor.CursorAction.cancel key x y]

claims.name: Swf.AppCursor.fresh_lock_takes_no_motion
claims.statement:
∀ (st : Swf.AppCursor.CursorState) (s : Swf.AppCursor.WrapSample) (f : Swf.AppCursor.WrapFrame) (dx dy : Float),
  st.fresh = true →
    s.dx.isFinite = true ∧ s.dy.isFinite = true →
      dx.isFinite = true ∧ dy.isFinite = true →
        Swf.AppCursor.sampleStep st s f =
          Swf.AppCursor.sampleStep st
            { key := s.key, phase := s.phase, x := s.x, y := s.y, dx := dx, dy := dy, mouse := s.mouse } f

claims.name: Swf.AppCursor.initial_holds_nothing
claims.statement:
Swf.AppCursor.cursorInitial.taken = [] ∧
  Swf.AppCursor.cursorInitial.lock = Swf.AppCursor.PointerLock.free ∧ Swf.AppCursor.cursorInitial.drawn = false

claims.name: Swf.AppCursor.lock_holds_only_what_asked
claims.statement:
∀ (st : Swf.AppCursor.CursorState),
  (∀ (k : String) (x y : Float),
      st.lock = Swf.AppCursor.PointerLock.asked k x y →
        (Swf.AppCursor.cursorEvent st Swf.AppCursor.CursorEvent.locked).state.lock =
            Swf.AppCursor.PointerLock.held k x y ∧
          (Swf.AppCursor.cursorEvent st Swf.AppCursor.CursorEvent.locked).actions =
            [Swf.AppCursor.CursorAction.show x y]) ∧
    ((∀ (k : String) (x y : Float), st.lock ≠ Swf.AppCursor.PointerLock.asked k x y) →
      (∀ (k : String) (x y : Float), st.lock ≠ Swf.AppCursor.PointerLock.held k x y) →
        (Swf.AppCursor.cursorEvent st Swf.AppCursor.CursorEvent.locked).actions = [Swf.AppCursor.CursorAction.exit])

claims.name: Swf.AppCursor.locked_pointer_draws_its_cursor
claims.statement:
∀ (st st' : Swf.AppCursor.CursorState) (s : Swf.AppCursor.WrapSample) (f : Swf.AppCursor.WrapFrame) (x y lx ly : Float)
  (as : List Swf.AppCursor.CursorAction),
  st.lock = Swf.AppCursor.PointerLock.held s.key lx ly →
    s.phase.ends = false →
      Swf.AppCursor.sampleStep st s f = Swf.AppCursor.SampleStep.next st' x y as →
        as = [Swf.AppCursor.CursorAction.show x y] ∧
          st'.lock = Swf.AppCursor.PointerLock.held s.key x y ∧ st'.drawn = true

claims.name: Swf.AppCursor.lost_lock_cancels_the_drag
claims.statement:
∀ (st : Swf.AppCursor.CursorState) (key : String) (x y : Float),
  st.lock = Swf.AppCursor.PointerLock.held key x y →
    (Swf.AppCursor.cursorEvent st Swf.AppCursor.CursorEvent.unlocked).state.lock = Swf.AppCursor.PointerLock.free ∧
      (Swf.AppCursor.cursorEvent st Swf.AppCursor.CursorEvent.unlocked).state.drawn = false ∧
        (Swf.AppCursor.cursorEvent st Swf.AppCursor.CursorEvent.unlocked).actions.head? =
          some (Swf.AppCursor.CursorAction.cancel key x y)

claims.name: Swf.AppCursor.no_lock_where_unavailable
claims.statement:
∀ (st st' : Swf.AppCursor.CursorState) (s : Swf.AppCursor.WrapSample) (f : Swf.AppCursor.WrapFrame) (x y : Float)
  (as : List Swf.AppCursor.CursorAction),
  f.lockable = false →
    Swf.AppCursor.sampleStep st s f = Swf.AppCursor.SampleStep.next st' x y as →
      ¬Swf.AppCursor.CursorAction.request ∈ as

claims.name: Swf.AppCursor.only_samples_ask
claims.statement:
∀ (st : Swf.AppCursor.CursorState) (e : Swf.AppCursor.CursorEvent),
  ¬Swf.AppCursor.CursorAction.request ∈ (Swf.AppCursor.cursorEvent st e).actions

claims.name: Swf.AppCursor.refusal_holds_for_the_stroke
claims.statement:
∀ (st st' : Swf.AppCursor.CursorState) (s : Swf.AppCursor.WrapSample) (f : Swf.AppCursor.WrapFrame) (x y : Float)
  (as : List Swf.AppCursor.CursorAction) (k : String),
  st.lock = Swf.AppCursor.PointerLock.refused k →
    Swf.AppCursor.sampleStep st s f = Swf.AppCursor.SampleStep.next st' x y as →
      ¬Swf.AppCursor.CursorAction.request ∈ as

claims.name: Swf.AppCursor.released_pointer_keeps_no_lock
claims.statement:
∀ (st : Swf.AppCursor.CursorState) (key : String) (x y : Float),
  st.lock = Swf.AppCursor.PointerLock.held key x y ∨ st.lock = Swf.AppCursor.PointerLock.asked key x y →
    (Swf.AppCursor.cursorEvent st (Swf.AppCursor.CursorEvent.released key)).state.lock =
        Swf.AppCursor.PointerLock.letting ∧
      Swf.AppCursor.CursorAction.exit ∈
          (Swf.AppCursor.cursorEvent st (Swf.AppCursor.CursorEvent.released key)).actions ∧
        ¬key ∈ (Swf.AppCursor.cursorEvent st (Swf.AppCursor.CursorEvent.released key)).state.taken

claims.name: Swf.AppCursor.stroke_end_lets_the_lock_go
claims.statement:
∀ (st st' : Swf.AppCursor.CursorState) (s : Swf.AppCursor.WrapSample) (f : Swf.AppCursor.WrapFrame) (x y lx ly : Float)
  (as : List Swf.AppCursor.CursorAction),
  st.lock = Swf.AppCursor.PointerLock.held s.key lx ly ∨ st.lock = Swf.AppCursor.PointerLock.asked s.key lx ly →
    s.phase.ends = true →
      Swf.AppCursor.sampleStep st s f = Swf.AppCursor.SampleStep.next st' x y as →
        Swf.AppCursor.CursorAction.exit ∈ as ∧
          st'.lock = Swf.AppCursor.PointerLock.letting ∧ ∀ (a b : Float), ¬Swf.AppCursor.CursorAction.show a b ∈ as

claims.name: Swf.AppCursor.stroke_end_lets_the_pointer_go
claims.statement:
∀ (st : Swf.AppCursor.CursorState) (key : String) (phase : Swf.AppCursor.WrapPhase) (consumed : Bool),
  phase.ends = true →
    ¬key ∈ (Swf.AppCursor.cursorEvent st (Swf.AppCursor.CursorEvent.dispatched key phase consumed)).state.taken

claims.name: Swf.AppCursor.taken_only_on_consumed_down
claims.statement:
∀ (st : Swf.AppCursor.CursorState) (key k : String) (phase : Swf.AppCursor.WrapPhase) (consumed : Bool),
  k ∈ (Swf.AppCursor.cursorEvent st (Swf.AppCursor.CursorEvent.dispatched key phase consumed)).state.taken →
    ¬k ∈ st.taken → phase = Swf.AppCursor.WrapPhase.down ∧ consumed = true ∧ k = key

claims.name: Swf.AppCursor.taken_stays_distinct
claims.statement:
∀ (taken : List String) (key : String) (phase : Swf.AppCursor.WrapPhase) (consumed : Bool),
  taken.Nodup → (Swf.AppCursor.takenAfter taken key phase consumed).Nodup

claims.name: Swf.AppCursor.untaken_passes_unchanged
claims.statement:
∀ (st st' : Swf.AppCursor.CursorState) (s : Swf.AppCursor.WrapSample) (f : Swf.AppCursor.WrapFrame) (x y : Float)
  (as : List Swf.AppCursor.CursorAction),
  ¬s.key ∈ st.taken ∨ f.wraps = false →
    (∀ (lx ly : Float), st.lock ≠ Swf.AppCursor.PointerLock.held s.key lx ly) →
      Swf.AppCursor.sampleStep st s f = Swf.AppCursor.SampleStep.next st' x y as → x = s.x ∧ y = s.y

claims.name: Swf.AppCursor.wraps_only_held_pointers_in_wrapping_views
claims.statement:
∀ (st st' : Swf.AppCursor.CursorState) (s : Swf.AppCursor.WrapSample) (f : Swf.AppCursor.WrapFrame) (x y : Float)
  (as : List Swf.AppCursor.CursorAction),
  (∀ (lx ly : Float), st.lock ≠ Swf.AppCursor.PointerLock.held s.key lx ly) →
    Swf.AppCursor.sampleStep st s f = Swf.AppCursor.SampleStep.next st' x y as →
      x ≠ s.x → f.wraps = true ∧ s.key ∈ st.taken ∧ s.phase ≠ Swf.AppCursor.WrapPhase.down

claims.name: Swf.AppDepth.band_by_thresholds
claims.statement:
∀ (q : Swf.AppDepth.DepthQuery) (out : Array Swf.AppDepth.DepthBand),
  Swf.AppDepth.depthBands q = Swf.AppDepth.DepthAnswer.bands out →
    ∀ (i : Nat) (hi : i < q.distances.size),
      q.focused ≠ some i →
        ∃ hi',
          (out[i] = Swf.AppDepth.DepthBand.full ↔ Swf.Order.floatKey q.distances[i] < Swf.Order.floatKey q.bands.full) ∧
            (out[i] = Swf.AppDepth.DepthBand.label ↔
              Swf.Order.floatKey q.bands.full ≤ Swf.Order.floatKey q.distances[i] ∧
                Swf.Order.floatKey q.bands.compact ≤ Swf.Order.floatKey q.distances[i])

claims.name: Swf.AppDepth.focused_full
claims.statement:
∀ (q : Swf.AppDepth.DepthQuery) (out : Array Swf.AppDepth.DepthBand),
  Swf.AppDepth.depthBands q = Swf.AppDepth.DepthAnswer.bands out →
    ∀ (i : Nat), i < q.distances.size → q.focused = some i → ∃ hi', out[i] = Swf.AppDepth.DepthBand.full

claims.name: Swf.AppDepth.invalid_bands_refused
claims.statement:
∀ (q : Swf.AppDepth.DepthQuery),
  (q.bands.full.isNaN || q.bands.compact.isNaN) = true →
    Swf.AppDepth.depthBands q = Swf.AppDepth.DepthAnswer.invalidBands

claims.name: Swf.AppDepth.invalid_distance_refused
claims.statement:
∀ (q : Swf.AppDepth.DepthQuery) (i : Nat),
  Swf.AppDepth.depthBands q = Swf.AppDepth.DepthAnswer.invalidDistance i →
    i < q.distances.size ∧ Swf.AppDepth.distanceOk q.distances[i]! = false

claims.name: Swf.AppDepth.monotone
claims.statement:
∀ (q : Swf.AppDepth.DepthQuery) (out : Array Swf.AppDepth.DepthBand),
  Swf.AppDepth.depthBands q = Swf.AppDepth.DepthAnswer.bands out →
    ∀ (i j : Nat) (hi : i < q.distances.size) (hj : j < q.distances.size),
      q.focused ≠ some i →
        q.focused ≠ some j →
          Swf.Order.floatKey q.distances[i] ≤ Swf.Order.floatKey q.distances[j] → ∃ hi' hj', out[j].shown ≤ out[i].shown

claims.name: Swf.AppDepth.one_band_per_window
claims.statement:
∀ (q : Swf.AppDepth.DepthQuery) (out : Array Swf.AppDepth.DepthBand),
  Swf.AppDepth.depthBands q = Swf.AppDepth.DepthAnswer.bands out → out.size = q.distances.size

claims.name: Swf.AppExperiments.custom_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (f : Swf.AppFeatures.FeatureFlags),
  Swf.AppExperiments.experimentOf f = none ↔
    ∀ (e : Swf.AppExperiments.Experiment), Swf.AppExperiments.experimentFlags e ≠ f

claims.name: Swf.AppExperiments.plan_isolates
claims.statement:
∀ (e : Swf.AppExperiments.Experiment) (c : Swf.AppExperiments.ExperimentContext) (k : Swf.AppExperiments.Capability),
  Swf.AppExperiments.holds (Swf.AppExperiments.experimentPlan e c).enabled k =
    match Swf.AppExperiments.isolates e with

∀ (movingId : String) (m : Swf.AppSnap.SnapSeen) (neighbours : Array Swf.AppSnap.SnapNeighbour)
  (settings : Swf.AppFeatures.SnapSettings) (rings : Array Float) (a d u : Option Swf.AppSnap.SnapCandidate),
  Swf.AppSnap.snapResolve movingId m neighbours settings rings = Swf.AppSnap.SnapOutcome.snapped a d u →
    ∀ (c : Swf.AppSnap.SnapCandidate),
      a = some c ∨ d = some c ∨ u = some c →
        ∃ o,
          o ∈ Swf.AppSnap.snapOptions movingId m neighbours settings rings ∧
            o.candidate = c ∧ ↑(Swf.Order.magnitudeKey o.distance) ≤ Swf.Order.floatKey o.threshold

claims.name: Swf.AppSnap.unseen_no_snap
claims.statement:
∀ (movingId : String) (m : Swf.AppSnap.SnapSeen) (neighbours : Array Swf.AppSnap.SnapNeighbour)
  (settings : Swf.AppFeatures.SnapSettings) (rings : Array Float),
  Swf.AppSnap.snapInvalid m neighbours settings rings = none →
    ¬m.distance > 0 → Swf.AppSnap.snapResolve movingId m neighbours settings rings = Swf.AppSnap.SnapOutcome.unsnapped

claims.name: Swf.AppSnap.unsnapped_iff_nothing_reachable
claims.statement:
∀ (movingId : String) (m : Swf.AppSnap.SnapSeen) (neighbours : Array Swf.AppSnap.SnapNeighbour)
  (settings : Swf.AppFeatures.SnapSettings) (rings : Array Float),
  Swf.AppSnap.snapInvalid m neighbours settings rings = none →
    m.distance > 0 →
      (Swf.AppSnap.snapResolve movingId m neighbours settings rings = Swf.AppSnap.SnapOutcome.unsnapped ↔
        ∀ (o : Swf.AppSnap.SnapOption),
          o ∈ Swf.AppSnap.snapOptions movingId m neighbours settings rings → o.reachable = false)

claims.name: Swf.AppWheel.commits_only_the_burst_under_way
claims.statement:
∀ (current : Option Swf.AppWheel.Burst) (event : Swf.AppWheel.WheelEvent) (s : Swf.AppWheel.WheelStep)
  (b : Swf.AppWheel.Burst),
  Swf.AppWheel.wheelStep current event = Swf.AppWheel.WheelOutcome.step s →
    Swf.AppWheel.WheelAction.commit b ∈ s.actions →
      current = some b ∧
        event ≠ Swf.AppWheel.WheelEvent.cancel ∧ s.actions.head? = some (Swf.AppWheel.WheelAction.commit b)

claims.name: Swf.AppWheel.ends_leave_no_burst
claims.statement:
∀ (current : Option Swf.AppWheel.Burst) (event : Swf.AppWheel.WheelEvent) (s : Swf.AppWheel.WheelStep),
  event = Swf.AppWheel.WheelEvent.settle ∨ event = Swf.AppWheel.WheelEvent.cancel →
    Swf.AppWheel.wheelStep current event = Swf.AppWheel.WheelOutcome.step s → s.burst = none

claims.name: Swf.AppWheel.shows_the_burst_under_way
claims.statement:
∀ (current : Option Swf.AppWheel.Burst) (event : Swf.AppWheel.WheelEvent) (s : Swf.AppWheel.WheelStep)
  (b : Swf.AppWheel.Burst),
  Swf.AppWheel.wheelStep current event = Swf.AppWheel.WheelOutcome.step s →

claims.name: Swf.AppWheel.tick_refused_iff_not_finite
claims.statement:
∀ (current : Option Swf.AppWheel.Burst) (nodeId : String) (carries : Swf.AppWheel.Carries) (delta : Float),
  Swf.AppWheel.wheelStep current (Swf.AppWheel.WheelEvent.tick nodeId carries delta) =
      Swf.AppWheel.WheelOutcome.invalidDelta ↔
    delta.isFinite = false

claims.name: Swf.AppWheel.ticks_add_up
claims.statement:
∀ (b : Swf.AppWheel.Burst) (delta : Float) (s : Swf.AppWheel.WheelStep),
  delta.isFinite = true →
    Swf.AppWheel.wheelStep (some b) (Swf.AppWheel.WheelEvent.tick b.nodeId b.carries delta) =
        Swf.AppWheel.WheelOutcome.step s →
      s.burst = some { nodeId := b.nodeId, carries := b.carries, turned := b.turned + delta } ∧
        s.actions =
          [Swf.AppWheel.WheelAction.show { nodeId := b.nodeId, carries := b.carries, turned := b.turned + delta }]

claims.name: Swf.AppWorkspaces.autosave_only_when_dirty

claims.name: Swf.AppWorkspaces.disposed_refuses_events
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.AppWorkspaces.WorkspacesMachine) (e : Swf.AppWorkspaces.WorkspacesEvent),
  m.disposed = true →
    Swf.AppWorkspaces.workspacesStep m e =
      match e with
      | Swf.AppWorkspaces.WorkspacesEvent.dispose => Swf.AppWorkspaces.WorkspacesStep.quiet m
      | x =>
        have __src := Swf.AppWorkspaces.WorkspacesStep.quiet m;
        { next := __src.next, cancelTimer := __src.cancelTimer, startTimer := __src.startTimer, save := __src.save,
          announce := __src.announce, refusal := some Swf.AppWorkspaces.disposedRefusal }

claims.name: Swf.AppWorkspaces.disposed_schedules_nothing
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.AppWorkspaces.WorkspacesMachine) (e : Swf.AppWorkspaces.WorkspacesEvent),

    (Swf.AppWorkspaces.workspacesStep m e).startTimer = false ∧ (Swf.AppWorkspaces.workspacesStep m e).save = false

claims.name: Swf.AppWorkspaces.import_needs_json_text

claims.name: Swf.AppWorkspaces.migration_keeps_stored

claims.name: Swf.AppWorkspaces.off_cancels_scheduled_save
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.AppWorkspaces.WorkspacesMachine) (saver : Swf.AppWorkspaces.SaverState),
  m.autosave = true →

      (Swf.AppWorkspaces.workspacesStep m (Swf.AppWorkspaces.WorkspacesEvent.setAutosave false saver)).next.pending =

claims.name: Swf.AppWorkspaces.restores_when_stored
claims.statement: ∀ (visits : Array (String × Int)), (Swf.AppWorkspaces.workspacesNewest visits).isSome = true ↔ visits.size > 0

claims.name: Swf.AppWorkspaces.save_now_needs_autosave
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.AppWorkspaces.WorkspacesMachine),
  m.autosave = false →
    m.disposed = false →
      (Swf.AppWorkspaces.workspacesStep m Swf.AppWorkspaces.WorkspacesEvent.saveNow).refusal = some "saving is off" ∧
        (Swf.AppWorkspaces.workspacesStep m Swf.AppWorkspaces.WorkspacesEvent.saveNow).save = false

claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.AppWorkspaces.WorkspacesMachine) (e : Swf.AppWorkspaces.WorkspacesEvent),

      ((Swf.AppWorkspaces.workspacesStep m e).startTimer = true →

claims.name: Swf.Arbitration.covered_frames_dropped
claims.statement:
∀ (hits : Array Swf.Arbitration.Hit) (i j : Nat),
  i < hits.size →
    j < hits.size →
      hits[i]!.node = hits[j]!.node →
        (hits[i]!.surface = none →
            hits[i]!.region = Swf.Arbitration.HitRegion.chrome →
              hits[j]!.surface.isSome = true → Swf.Arbitration.keeps hits i = false) ∧
          (hits[i]!.surface.isSome = true →
            hits[j]!.surface = none →
              hits[j]!.region = Swf.Arbitration.HitRegion.resizeHandle → Swf.Arbitration.keeps hits i = false)

claims.name: Swf.Arbitration.front_before
claims.statement:
∀ (hits : Array Swf.Arbitration.Hit) (kept : List Nat) (tolerance : Float) (i j : Nat),
  hits[i]!.front = true →
    hits[i]!.reach = false →
      hits[j]!.front = false →
        Swf.Order.floatKey hits[i]!.priority = Swf.Order.floatKey hits[j]!.priority →
          Swf.Arbitration.keyLe (Swf.Arbitration.hitKey hits kept tolerance i)
              (Swf.Arbitration.hitKey hits kept tolerance j) =
            true

claims.name: Swf.Arbitration.invalid_hit_named
claims.statement:
∀ (hits : Array Swf.Arbitration.Hit) (tolerance : Float) (i : Nat) (field : String),
  Swf.Arbitration.pickOrder hits tolerance = Swf.Arbitration.PickOutcome.invalidHit i field →
    i < hits.size ∧
      (field = "distance" ∧ hits[i]!.distance.isFinite = false ∨
        field = "priority" ∧ hits[i]!.distance.isFinite = true ∧ hits[i]!.priority.isFinite = false)

claims.name: Swf.Arbitration.nonfinite_priority_refused
claims.statement:
∀ (bids : Array Swf.Arbitration.Bid) (kind : Swf.Arbitration.BidKind) (pointers i : Nat),
  Swf.Arbitration.bestBid bids kind pointers = Swf.Arbitration.BidOutcome.invalidPriority i ↔
    i < bids.size ∧ bids[i]!.priority.isFinite = false ∧ ∀ (j : Nat), j < i → bids[j]!.priority.isFinite = true

claims.name: Swf.Arbitration.occluded_by_nearer
claims.statement:
∀ (hits : Array Swf.Arbitration.Hit) (tolerance : Float) (po : Swf.Arbitration.PickOrder),
  Swf.Arbitration.pickOrder hits tolerance = Swf.Arbitration.PickOutcome.ordered po →
    ∀ (k : Nat),
      k < po.order.length →
        (po.occluded[k]! = true ↔
          hits[po.order[k]!]!.region ≠ Swf.Arbitration.HitRegion.titleBar ∧
            hits[po.order[k]!]!.front = false ∧
              ∃ j,
                j ∈ List.filter (Swf.Arbitration.keeps hits) (List.range hits.size) ∧
                  j ≠ po.order[k]! ∧
                    hits[j]!.occluding = true ∧
                      hits[j]!.reach = false ∧
                        Swf.Order.floatKey (hits[j]!.distance + tolerance) <
                          Swf.Order.floatKey hits[po.order[k]!]!.distance)

claims.name: Swf.Arbitration.order_is_kept
claims.statement:
∀ (hits : Array Swf.Arbitration.Hit) (tolerance : Float) (po : Swf.Arbitration.PickOrder),
  Swf.Arbitration.pickOrder hits tolerance = Swf.Arbitration.PickOutcome.ordered po →
    po.order.Perm (List.filter (Swf.Arbitration.keeps hits) (List.range hits.size))

claims.name: Swf.Arbitration.ordered_iff_finite
claims.statement:
∀ (hits : Array Swf.Arbitration.Hit) (tolerance : Float),
  (∃ po, Swf.Arbitration.pickOrder hits tolerance = Swf.Arbitration.PickOutcome.ordered po) ↔
    (tolerance.isFinite = true ∧ 0 ≤ tolerance) ∧
      ∀ (i : Nat), i < hits.size → hits[i]!.distance.isFinite = true ∧ hits[i]!.priority.isFinite = true

claims.name: Swf.Arbitration.reach_after
claims.statement:
∀ (hits : Array Swf.Arbitration.Hit) (kept : List Nat) (tolerance : Float) (i j : Nat),
  hits[i]!.reach = false →
    hits[j]!.reach = true →
      Swf.Order.floatKey hits[i]!.priority = Swf.Order.floatKey hits[j]!.priority →
        Swf.Arbitration.keyLe (Swf.Arbitration.hitKey hits kept tolerance i)
            (Swf.Arbitration.hitKey hits kept tolerance j) =
          true

claims.name: Swf.Arbitration.reach_hides_nothing
claims.statement:
∀ (hits : Array Swf.Arbitration.Hit) (kept : List Nat) (tolerance : Float) (i : Nat),
  (∀ (j : Nat), j ∈ kept → j ≠ i → hits[j]!.occluding = true → hits[j]!.reach = true) →
    Swf.Arbitration.occludedAt hits kept tolerance i = false

claims.name: Swf.Arbitration.refused_iff_nonfinite
claims.statement:
∀ (bids : Array Swf.Arbitration.Bid) (kind : Swf.Arbitration.BidKind) (pointers : Nat),
  (∃ i, Swf.Arbitration.bestBid bids kind pointers = Swf.Arbitration.BidOutcome.invalidPriority i) ↔
    ∃ j, j < bids.size ∧ bids[j]!.priority.isFinite = false

claims.name: Swf.Arbitration.target_ranks_first
claims.statement:
∀ (hits : Array Swf.Arbitration.Hit) (tolerance : Float) (po : Swf.Arbitration.PickOrder),
  Swf.Arbitration.pickOrder hits tolerance = Swf.Arbitration.PickOutcome.ordered po →
    ∀ (t : Nat),
      po.order.head? = some t →
        ∀ (j : Nat),
          j < hits.size →
            Swf.Arbitration.keeps hits j = true →
              Swf.Arbitration.keyLe
                  (Swf.Arbitration.hitKey hits (List.filter (Swf.Arbitration.keeps hits) (List.range hits.size))
                    tolerance t)
                  (Swf.Arbitration.hitKey hits (List.filter (Swf.Arbitration.keeps hits) (List.range hits.size))
                    tolerance j) =
                true

claims.name: Swf.Arbitration.titleBar_before
claims.statement:
∀ (hits : Array Swf.Arbitration.Hit) (kept : List Nat) (tolerance : Float) (i j : Nat),
  hits[i]!.region = Swf.Arbitration.HitRegion.titleBar →
    hits[i]!.front = false →
      hits[i]!.reach = false →
        hits[j]!.region ≠ Swf.Arbitration.HitRegion.titleBar →
          hits[j]!.front = false →
            Swf.Order.floatKey hits[i]!.priority = Swf.Order.floatKey hits[j]!.priority →
              Swf.Arbitration.keyLe (Swf.Arbitration.hitKey hits kept tolerance i)
                  (Swf.Arbitration.hitKey hits kept tolerance j) =
                true

claims.name: Swf.Arbitration.titleBar_covers_own_surface
claims.statement:
∀ (hits : Array Swf.Arbitration.Hit) (i j : Nat),
  j < hits.size →
    hits[i]!.node = hits[j]!.node →
      hits[i]!.surface.isSome = true →
        hits[j]!.surface = none →
          hits[j]!.region = Swf.Arbitration.HitRegion.titleBar → Swf.Arbitration.keeps hits i = false

claims.name: Swf.Arbitration.winner_eligible
claims.statement:
∀ (bids : Array Swf.Arbitration.Bid) (kind : Swf.Arbitration.BidKind) (pointers i : Nat),
  Swf.Arbitration.bestBid bids kind pointers = Swf.Arbitration.BidOutcome.winner i →
    i < bids.size ∧
      bids[i]!.kind = kind ∧
        bids[i]!.pointers = pointers ∧ ∀ (j : Nat), j < bids.size → bids[j]!.priority.isFinite = true

claims.name: Swf.Arbitration.winner_exists_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (bids : Array Swf.Arbitration.Bid) (kind : Swf.Arbitration.BidKind) (pointers : Nat),
  (∃ i, Swf.Arbitration.bestBid bids kind pointers = Swf.Arbitration.BidOutcome.winner i) ↔
    (∀ (j : Nat), j < bids.size → bids[j]!.priority.isFinite = true) ∧
      ∃ j, j < bids.size ∧ Swf.Arbitration.eligibleBid bids kind pointers j = true

claims.name: Swf.Arbitration.winner_ranks_first
claims.statement:
∀ (bids : Array Swf.Arbitration.Bid) (kind : Swf.Arbitration.BidKind) (pointers i : Nat),
  Swf.Arbitration.bestBid bids kind pointers = Swf.Arbitration.BidOutcome.winner i →
    ∀ (j : Nat),
      j < bids.size →
        Swf.Arbitration.eligibleBid bids kind pointers j = true →
          Swf.Arbitration.keyLe (Swf.Arbitration.bidKey bids[i]!) (Swf.Arbitration.bidKey bids[j]!) = true

claims.name: Swf.Fallback.cards_need_scaling
claims.statement:
∀ (c : Swf.Fallback.NegotiationContext) (f : Swf.Fallback.FragmentFacts) (r : Swf.Fallback.Negotiated),
  Swf.Fallback.negotiateOne c f = some r →
    r.mode = Swf.Fallback.Mode.exact ∨ r.mode = Swf.Fallback.Mode.native →
      Swf.Fallback.TransformMode.affine2d.rank ≤ c.renderer.transformMode.rank

claims.name: Swf.Fallback.exact_only_drawable
claims.statement:
∀ (c : Swf.Fallback.NegotiationContext) (f : Swf.Fallback.FragmentFacts) (r : Swf.Fallback.Negotiated),
  Swf.Fallback.negotiateOne c f = some r →
    (r.mode = Swf.Fallback.Mode.exact → ∃ hc, f.handle = some hc ∧ hc.strategy = Swf.Fallback.Strategy.drawable) ∧
      (f.handle = none → r.mode = Swf.Fallback.Mode.placeholder)

claims.name: Swf.Fallback.first_allowed_in_order
claims.statement:
∀ (c : Swf.Fallback.NegotiationContext) (f : Swf.Fallback.FragmentFacts) (r : Swf.Fallback.Negotiated),
  Swf.Fallback.negotiateOne c f = some r →
    ∃ before after,
      Swf.Fallback.representedModes f.represented f.order = before ++ r.mode :: after ∧
        Swf.Fallback.gapsFor c f r.mode = [] ∧
          (∀ (m : Swf.Fallback.Mode), m ∈ before → Swf.Fallback.gapsFor c f m ≠ []) ∧
            r.gaps = (List.map (Swf.Fallback.gapsFor c f) before).flatten

claims.name: Swf.Fallback.frame_is_each
claims.statement:
∀ (c : Swf.Fallback.NegotiationContext) (fs : Array Swf.Fallback.FragmentFacts) (i : Nat) (hi : i < fs.size),
  (Swf.Fallback.negotiateFrame c fs)[i] = Swf.Fallback.negotiateOne c fs[i]

claims.name: Swf.Fallback.live_needs_owner
claims.statement:
∀ (c : Swf.Fallback.NegotiationContext) (f : Swf.Fallback.FragmentFacts) (r : Swf.Fallback.Negotiated),
  Swf.Fallback.negotiateOne c f = some r →
    r.mode ≠ Swf.Fallback.Mode.proxy ∧ r.mode ≠ Swf.Fallback.Mode.placeholder →
      f.owner = true ∧ ∃ hc, f.handle = some hc ∧ hc.strategy ≠ Swf.Fallback.Strategy.proxyOnly

claims.name: Swf.Fallback.owner_rule
claims.statement:
∀ (f : Swf.Fallback.FragmentFacts),
  f.owner = true ↔
    f.viewportOwns = true ∧
      (f.nativeOwner = true ∨ ∃ h, f.handle = some h ∧ h.strategy = Swf.Fallback.Strategy.drawable ∧ h.shared = true)

claims.name: Swf.Fallback.placeholder_last_resort
claims.statement:
∀ (c : Swf.Fallback.NegotiationContext) (f : Swf.Fallback.FragmentFacts),
  Swf.Fallback.Mode.placeholder ∈ f.order → (Swf.Fallback.negotiateOne c f).isSome = true

claims.name: Swf.Fallback.policy_valid
claims.statement:
∀ (order : List String),
  Swf.Fallback.policyIssue order = none →
    ∃ ms, List.map Swf.Fallback.modeOf order = List.map some ms ∧ ms.Nodup ∧ order.getLast? = some "placeholder"

claims.name: Swf.Fallback.represented_only_stand_ins
claims.statement:
∀ (order : List Swf.Fallback.Mode),
  (∀ (m : Swf.Fallback.Mode),
      m ∈ Swf.Fallback.representedModes true order → m = Swf.Fallback.Mode.proxy ∨ m = Swf.Fallback.Mode.placeholder) ∧
    (Swf.Fallback.representedModes true order).Sublist order ∧ Swf.Fallback.representedModes false order = order

claims.name: Swf.Gesture.background_turns_and_zooms
claims.statement:
∀ (f : Swf.Gesture.WheelFacts),
  (Swf.Gesture.wheelRoute f = Swf.Gesture.WheelRoute.zoomView ↔
      f.pressed = false ∧ f.pick = Swf.Gesture.PressPick.background ∧ f.zoom = true) ∧

claims.name: Swf.Gesture.beyond_slop_iff
claims.statement: ∀ (distance slop : Float), Swf.Gesture.beyondSlop distance slop = true ↔ distance > slop

claims.name: Swf.Gesture.changed_iff_not_selected

claims.name: Swf.Gesture.commit_at_most_once

∀ (e : Swf.Gesture.GestureEvent),

claims.name: Swf.Gesture.commit_only_by_finish
claims.statement:
∀ (p : Swf.Gesture.GesturePhase) (e : Swf.Gesture.GestureEvent),
  Swf.Gesture.gestureStep p e = some Swf.Gesture.GesturePhase.committed →
    p = Swf.Gesture.GesturePhase.dragging ∧ e = Swf.Gesture.GestureEvent.finished Swf.Gesture.Finish.committed

claims.name: Swf.Gesture.content_keeps_the_wheel
claims.statement:
∀ (zoom sideways : Bool),
  Swf.Gesture.wheelRoute
      { pressed := false, pick := Swf.Gesture.PressPick.hit, region := Swf.Gesture.Region.content, proxy := false,
        zoom := zoom, sideways := sideways } =
    Swf.Gesture.WheelRoute.native

claims.name: Swf.Gesture.depth_move_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (f : Swf.Gesture.WheelFacts),
  Swf.Gesture.wheelRoute f = Swf.Gesture.WheelRoute.depthMove ↔
    f.pressed = false ∧
      f.pick = Swf.Gesture.PressPick.hit ∧
        f.zoom = false ∧

        a ∈ pre ∧
          a.snd = true ∧ (Swf.Names.overlaps a.fst b.fst = true ∧ a.fst.owner ≠ b.fst.owner ∨ a.fst.name = b.fst.name)

claims.name: Swf.Names.kept_written
claims.statement:
∀ (boxes : Array Swf.Names.LabelBox) (b : Swf.Names.LabelBox × Bool),

claims.name: Swf.Names.labels_answered
claims.statement: ∀ (boxes : Array Swf.Names.LabelBox), (Swf.Names.labelsShown boxes).size = boxes.size

claims.name: Swf.Names.written_names_clear
claims.statement:
∀ (boxes : Array Swf.Names.LabelBox),

    (fun a b =>
      a.snd = true →
        b.snd = true →
          b.fst.kept = false →
            (Swf.Names.overlaps a.fst b.fst = false ∨ a.fst.owner = b.fst.owner) ∧ a.fst.name ≠ b.fst.name)

claims.statement:
Swf.Presenter.slotStep Swf.Presenter.Slot.opening Swf.Presenter.SlotEvent.closed = some Swf.Presenter.Slot.absent ∧

claims.name: Swf.Presenter.listed_iff_open
claims.statement: ∀ (s : Swf.Presenter.Slot), Swf.Presenter.slotListed s = true ↔ s = Swf.Presenter.Slot.open

claims.name: Swf.Presenter.open_once

∀ (s : Swf.Presenter.Slot),

claims.name: Swf.Room.across_and_up_keeps_the_floor

claims.name: Swf.Room.along_the_floor_keeps_the_height
claims.statement:
∀ (l : Swf.Room.RoomLimits) (pace : Swf.Room.RoomPace) (d : Swf.Room.RoomDrag),

claims.name: Swf.Room.drag_stays_in_room
claims.statement:
∀ (l : Swf.Room.RoomLimits) (pace : Swf.Room.RoomPace) (d : Swf.Room.RoomDrag),

claims.name: Swf.Room.drop_stays_in_room
claims.statement: ∀ (l : Swf.Room.RoomLimits) (p : Swf.Room.RoomPlace) (x z : Float), l.ordered → l.holds (Swf.Room.floorDrop l p x z)

claims.name: Swf.Room.elevation_whatever_the_heading

∀ (p : Swf.Room.RoomPlace) (a : Float),
  Swf.Room.elevationOf { heading := a, floor := p.floor, height := p.height } = Swf.Room.elevationOf p

claims.name: Swf.Room.heading_by_motion_across
claims.statement:
∀ (l : Swf.Room.RoomLimits) (pace : Swf.Room.RoomPace) (d : Swf.Room.RoomDrag),

claims.name: Swf.Room.height_per_pixel_whatever_the_distance
claims.statement:
∀ (l : Swf.Room.RoomLimits) (pace : Swf.Room.RoomPace) (d : Swf.Room.RoomDrag) (r : Float),

        {

claims.name: Swf.Room.keepInRoom_holds
claims.statement: ∀ (l : Swf.Room.RoomLimits) (p : Swf.Room.RoomPlace), l.ordered → l.holds (Swf.Room.keepInRoom l p)

claims.name: Swf.Room.place_in_room
claims.statement: ∀ (l : Swf.Room.RoomLimits) (x y z : Float), l.ordered → l.holds (Swf.Room.placeOf l x y z)

claims.name: Swf.Room.place_read_to_precision
claims.statement:
∀ (l : Swf.Room.RoomLimits) (x y z : Float),
  Swf.Room.placeOf l x y z =
    Swf.Room.keepInRoom l

        height := Swf.Room.readToPrecision y }

claims.name: Swf.Room.point_at_its_height
claims.statement: ∀ (p : Swf.Room.RoomPlace), (Swf.Room.pointOf p).y = p.height

claims.name: Swf.Room.wheel_keeps_heading_and_height
claims.statement:
∀ (l : Swf.Room.RoomLimits) (pace : Swf.Room.RoomPace) (p : Swf.Room.RoomPlace) (deltaY : Float),

    (Swf.Room.wheelOnFloor l pace p deltaY).height = Swf.Room.keepWithin p.height l.lowest l.highest

claims.name: Swf.Room.wheel_stays_in_room
claims.statement:
∀ (l : Swf.Room.RoomLimits) (pace : Swf.Room.RoomPace) (p : Swf.Room.RoomPlace) (deltaY : Float),

claims.name: Swf.Save.ack_cleans_or_dirties
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.Save.SaveMachine) (captured changes : Int) (revision : Nat),
  (∀ (r : Nat), m.savedRevision = some r → r ≤ revision) →
    have e := Swf.Save.saveEnd m captured changes (Swf.Save.SaveAnswer.acknowledged true revision);
    e.refused = none ∧
      e.next.savedRevision = some revision ∧
        e.next.savedChanges = some captured ∧
          (e.next.state = Swf.Save.SaveState.clean ↔ changes = captured) ∧ Swf.Save.Consistent e.next

claims.name: Swf.Save.change_dirties
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.Save.SaveMachine) (c : Int),
  Swf.Save.Consistent (Swf.Save.saveChanged m c) ∧
    (m.state = Swf.Save.SaveState.clean → (Swf.Save.saveChanged m c).state = Swf.Save.SaveState.dirty) ∧
      (m.state ≠ Swf.Save.SaveState.clean → (Swf.Save.saveChanged m c).state = m.state)

claims.name: Swf.Save.failure_keeps_saved
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.Save.SaveMachine) (captured changes : Int) (a : Swf.Save.SaveAnswer),
  (Swf.Save.saveEnd m captured changes a).next.state ≠ Swf.Save.SaveState.clean ∧
      (Swf.Save.saveEnd m captured changes a).next.state ≠ Swf.Save.SaveState.dirty →
    (Swf.Save.saveEnd m captured changes a).next.state = Swf.Save.SaveState.failed ∧
      (Swf.Save.saveEnd m captured changes a).next.savedRevision = m.savedRevision ∧
        (Swf.Save.saveEnd m captured changes a).next.savedChanges = m.savedChanges

claims.name: Swf.Save.open_clean_iff_saved
claims.statement:
∀ (r : Option Nat) (s : Option Int) (c : Int),
  Swf.Save.Consistent (Swf.Save.saveOpen r s c) ∧
    ((Swf.Save.saveOpen r s c).state = Swf.Save.SaveState.clean ↔ s = some c)

claims.name: Swf.Save.revision_never_goes_back
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.Save.SaveMachine) (captured changes : Int) (a : Swf.Save.SaveAnswer) (r : Nat),
  m.savedRevision = some r → ∃ r', (Swf.Save.saveEnd m captured changes a).next.savedRevision = some r' ∧ r ≤ r'

claims.name: Swf.Save.save_skips_unchanged
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.Save.SaveMachine) (c : Int),
  (Swf.Save.saveBegin m c = none ↔ m.savedChanges = some c) ∧
    ∀ (m' : Swf.Save.SaveMachine),
      Swf.Save.saveBegin m c = some m' → m'.state = Swf.Save.SaveState.saving ∧ m'.savedRevision = m.savedRevision

claims.name: Swf.Spaces.active_changes_only_when_opened
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.Spaces.SpacesMachine) (e : Swf.Spaces.SpacesEvent),
  (Swf.Spaces.spacesStep m e).next.active ≠ m.active →
    (∃ t,
        e = Swf.Spaces.SpacesEvent.opened true ∧
          m.phase = Swf.Spaces.Phase.opening t ∧ (Swf.Spaces.spacesStep m e).next.active = some t) ∨
      ∃ n,
        e = Swf.Spaces.SpacesEvent.forked true ∧
          m.phase = Swf.Spaces.Phase.forking n ∧ (Swf.Spaces.spacesStep m e).next.active = some n

claims.name: Swf.Spaces.disposed_refuses
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.Spaces.SpacesMachine) (e : Swf.Spaces.SpacesEvent),
  m.disposed = true →
    Swf.Spaces.spacesStep m e =
      match e with
      | Swf.Spaces.SpacesEvent.dispose => Swf.Spaces.SpacesStep.quiet m
      | x => Swf.Spaces.SpacesStep.refuse m Swf.Spaces.SpacesRefusal.disposed

claims.name: Swf.Spaces.initial_idle
claims.statement:
Swf.Spaces.spacesInitial.active = none ∧
  Swf.Spaces.spacesInitial.phase = Swf.Spaces.Phase.idle ∧ Swf.Spaces.spacesInitial.disposed = false

claims.name: Swf.Spaces.name_valid
claims.statement:
∀ (name : Option String),
  Swf.Spaces.spacesNameIssue name = none ↔
    ∃ s,
      name = some s ∧
        s.toList ≠ [] ∧
          Option.any Swf.Spaces.jsSpace s.toList.head? = false ∧
            Option.any Swf.Spaces.jsSpace s.toList.getLast? = false ∧
              Swf.Spaces.utf16Length s ≤ Swf.Spaces.maxNameLength

claims.name: Swf.Spaces.off_keeps_space
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.Spaces.SpacesMachine) (t s : String) (known : Bool) (saver : Swf.Spaces.SaverState),
  m.disposed = false →
    m.active = some s →
      s ≠ t →
        m.phase = Swf.Spaces.Phase.idle →
          known = true →
            Swf.Spaces.spacesStep m (Swf.Spaces.SpacesEvent.request t known false saver) =
              Swf.Spaces.SpacesStep.refuse m Swf.Spaces.SpacesRefusal.off

claims.name: Swf.Spaces.open_only_when_saved_or_given_up
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.Spaces.SpacesMachine) (e : Swf.Spaces.SpacesEvent) (t : String),
  (Swf.Spaces.spacesStep m e).openTarget = some t →
    (∃ known on saver,
        e = Swf.Spaces.SpacesEvent.request t known on saver ∧ (m.active = none ∨ saver = Swf.Spaces.SaverState.clean)) ∨
      e = Swf.Spaces.SpacesEvent.saved true ∧ m.phase = Swf.Spaces.Phase.saving t ∨
        e = Swf.Spaces.SpacesEvent.answer true ∧ m.phase = Swf.Spaces.Phase.asking t

claims.name: Swf.Spaces.refused_changes_nothing
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.Spaces.SpacesMachine) (e : Swf.Spaces.SpacesEvent) (r : Swf.Spaces.SpacesRefusal),
  (Swf.Spaces.spacesStep m e).refusal = some r → Swf.Spaces.spacesStep m e = Swf.Spaces.SpacesStep.refuse m r

claims.name: Swf.Spaces.request_shown_or_busy
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.Spaces.SpacesMachine) (t : String) (known on : Bool) (saver : Swf.Spaces.SaverState),
  m.disposed = false →
    (m.phase = Swf.Spaces.Phase.idle →
        m.active = some t →
          Swf.Spaces.spacesStep m (Swf.Spaces.SpacesEvent.request t known on saver) = Swf.Spaces.SpacesStep.quiet m) ∧
      (m.phase ≠ Swf.Spaces.Phase.idle →
        Swf.Spaces.spacesStep m (Swf.Spaces.SpacesEvent.request t known on saver) =
          Swf.Spaces.SpacesStep.refuse m Swf.Spaces.SpacesRefusal.busy)

claims.name: Swf.Surface.announces_exactly
claims.statement:
∀ (p : Swf.Surface.Presentation) (e : Swf.Surface.SurfaceEvent),
  (Swf.Surface.surfaceStep p e).announce = true ↔ (Swf.Surface.surfaceStep p e).next ≠ p ∨ e.isFailure = true

claims.name: Swf.Surface.bind_only_from_unbound_or_error
claims.statement:
∀ (p : Swf.Surface.Presentation),
  Swf.Surface.bindGate true p = some Swf.Surface.SurfaceRefusal.disposed ∧
    (Swf.Surface.bindGate false p = none ↔
      (∃ r, p = Swf.Surface.Presentation.unbound r) ∨ p = Swf.Surface.Presentation.error)

claims.name: Swf.Surface.bindsOnAdapter_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (p : Swf.Surface.Presentation),
  Swf.Surface.bindsOnAdapter p = true ↔
    p = Swf.Surface.Presentation.unbound Swf.Surface.UnboundReason.adapterUnavailable

claims.name: Swf.Surface.detaching_only_from_active
claims.statement:
∀ (p : Swf.Surface.Presentation) (e : Swf.Surface.SurfaceEvent),
  (Swf.Surface.surfaceStep p e).next = Swf.Surface.Presentation.detaching →
    p ≠ Swf.Surface.Presentation.detaching → p.active = true

claims.name: Swf.Surface.error_only_on_failure
claims.statement:
∀ (p : Swf.Surface.Presentation) (e : Swf.Surface.SurfaceEvent),
  (Swf.Surface.surfaceStep p e).next = Swf.Surface.Presentation.error →
    p ≠ Swf.Surface.Presentation.error →
      p = Swf.Surface.Presentation.binding ∧ e = Swf.Surface.SurfaceEvent.resolved Swf.Surface.Resolution.failed ∨
        e = Swf.Surface.SurfaceEvent.fails

claims.name: Swf.Surface.handover_admits_single_mount
claims.statement:
∀ (f : Swf.Surface.HandoverFacts),
  Swf.Surface.handoverGate f = none ↔ f.singleOwner = true → f.severalViewports = false ∧ f.endpointElsewhere = false

claims.name: Swf.Surface.hide_releases_only_if_safe
claims.statement:
∀ (requested safeDetach : Bool),
  Swf.Surface.hideReleases requested safeDetach = true ↔ requested = true ∧ safeDetach = true

claims.name: Swf.Surface.holdsBinding_iff
claims.statement:
∀ (p : Swf.Surface.Presentation),
  Swf.Surface.holdsBinding p = true ↔
    p = Swf.Surface.Presentation.binding ∨
      p = Swf.Surface.Presentation.ready ∨ p = Swf.Surface.Presentation.presented ∨ p = Swf.Surface.Presentation.hidden

claims.name: Swf.Surface.move_and_hide_need_attachment
claims.statement:
∀ (disposed attached replacing : Bool),
  (Swf.Surface.moveGate disposed attached replacing = none ↔ disposed = false ∧ attached = true ∧ replacing = false) ∧
    (Swf.Surface.hideGate attached replacing = none ↔ attached = true ∧ replacing = false)

claims.name: Swf.Surface.present_admits_single_mount
claims.statement:
∀ (f : Swf.Surface.PresentFacts),
  Swf.Surface.presentGate f = none →
    f.disposed = false ∧
      f.replacing = false ∧
        f.phase.bound = true ∧
          f.existing ≠ some true ∧
            f.pending = false ∧
              (f.singleOwner = true → f.existing = none → f.attachedAnywhere = false ∧ f.endpointElsewhere = false)

claims.name: Swf.Surface.presented_needs_binding
claims.statement:
∀ (p : Swf.Surface.Presentation) (e : Swf.Surface.SurfaceEvent),
  (Swf.Surface.surfaceStep p e).next = Swf.Surface.Presentation.presented →
    p ≠ Swf.Surface.Presentation.presented → p.bound = true

claims.name: Swf.Surface.replace_only_when_bound
claims.statement:
∀ (disposed : Bool) (p : Swf.Surface.Presentation) (replacing hasAdapter pending : Bool),
  Swf.Surface.replaceGate disposed p replacing hasAdapter pending = none →
    disposed = false ∧ replacing = false ∧ p.bound = true ∧ hasAdapter = true ∧ pending = false

claims.name: Swf.Surface.unbind_cases
claims.statement:
∀ (p : Swf.Surface.Presentation) (replacing : Bool),
  (replacing = true →
      Swf.Surface.unbindGate p replacing = Swf.Surface.UnbindGate.refuse Swf.Surface.SurfaceRefusal.replacing) ∧
    (replacing = false →
        p = Swf.Surface.Presentation.detaching →
          Swf.Surface.unbindGate p replacing = Swf.Surface.UnbindGate.refuse Swf.Surface.SurfaceRefusal.detaching) ∧
      (replacing = false →
          (∃ r, p = Swf.Surface.Presentation.unbound r) →
            Swf.Surface.unbindGate p replacing = Swf.Surface.UnbindGate.done) ∧
        (replacing = false → p.active = true → Swf.Surface.unbindGate p replacing = Swf.Surface.UnbindGate.release)

claims.name: Swf.ViewMode.back_restores_entry_view
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.ViewMode.ModeMachine) (v current : Swf.ViewMode.ViewSettings) (r : Bool),
  current.mode = m.mode →
    m.origin = some v →
      Swf.ViewMode.transition m Swf.ViewMode.ModeEvent.back current r =
        Swf.ViewMode.ModeTransition.next (Swf.ViewMode.initial v.mode) v.mode (some v.projection)
          (if r = true then some v.camera else none)

claims.name: Swf.ViewMode.back_without_origin_refused
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.ViewMode.ModeMachine) (current : Swf.ViewMode.ViewSettings) (r : Bool),
  m.origin = none →
    ∃ reason,
      Swf.ViewMode.transition m Swf.ViewMode.ModeEvent.back current r = Swf.ViewMode.ModeTransition.refused reason

claims.name: Swf.ViewMode.mismatch_refused
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.ViewMode.ModeMachine) (e : Swf.ViewMode.ModeEvent) (current : Swf.ViewMode.ViewSettings) (r : Bool),
  current.mode ≠ m.mode → ∃ reason, Swf.ViewMode.transition m e current r = Swf.ViewMode.ModeTransition.refused reason

claims.name: Swf.ViewMode.next_mode_consistent
claims.statement:
∀ (m m' : Swf.ViewMode.ModeMachine) (e : Swf.ViewMode.ModeEvent) (current : Swf.ViewMode.ViewSettings) (r : Bool)
  (mode : String) (p : Option Swf.ViewMode.ProjectionSetting) (c : Option Swf.ViewMode.Quat),
  Swf.ViewMode.transition m e current r = Swf.ViewMode.ModeTransition.next m' mode p c → m'.mode = mode

claims.name: Swf.ViewMode.observed_follows_record
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.ViewMode.ModeMachine) (recorded : String),
  Swf.ViewMode.observed m m.mode = none ∧
    (m.mode ≠ recorded → Swf.ViewMode.observed m recorded = some { mode := recorded, origin := none })

claims.name: Swf.ViewMode.reenter_keeps_origin
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.ViewMode.ModeMachine) (current : Swf.ViewMode.ViewSettings) (r : Bool),
  current.mode = m.mode →
    Swf.ViewMode.transition m (Swf.ViewMode.ModeEvent.switch m.mode) current r =
      Swf.ViewMode.ModeTransition.next m m.mode none none

claims.name: Swf.ViewMode.switch_remembers_view_left
claims.statement:
∀ (m : Swf.ViewMode.ModeMachine) (current : Swf.ViewMode.ViewSettings) (to : String) (r : Bool),
  current.mode = m.mode →
    to ≠ m.mode →
      Swf.ViewMode.transition m (Swf.ViewMode.ModeEvent.switch to) current r =
        Swf.ViewMode.ModeTransition.next
          { mode := to, origin := some ((if r = true then m.origin else none).getD current) } to none
          (Option.map (fun x => x.camera) (if r = true then m.origin else none))
